findings.title: Missing input validation for category parameter
findings.description: The getEconomicData GraphQL resolver accepts a category string without validation. While Prisma prevents SQL injection, arbitrary category values could be used for enumeration attacks or cause unexpected behavior.
findings.suggested_issue: Add validation to ensure category is from a predefined list of allowed categories, or validate against existing categories in database

findings.title: Unsafe type assertion for metadata
findings.description: Metadata from database is cast to Record<string, unknown> without runtime validation. Malformed metadata could cause runtime errors or unexpected behavior when accessed.
findings.snippet: metadata: (point.item.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? null
findings.suggested_issue: Use a schema validation library (zod, io-ts) to validate metadata structure at runtime before casting

findings.title: Admin token transmitted in header without encryption check
findings.description: The admin token is sent via x-akshare-admin-token header. While HTTPS should protect it in transit, there's no verification that the connection is secure before sending sensitive credentials.
findings.suggested_issue: Add a check to ensure baseUrl uses HTTPS before sending admin token, or use a more secure authentication mechanism

findings.title: No rate limiting on upgrade endpoint
findings.description: The POST /admin/akshare/upgrade endpoint triggers a potentially destructive operation (pip upgrade + restart) without rate limiting. An authenticated attacker could repeatedly trigger upgrades causing DoS.
findings.suggested_issue: Add rate limiting (e.g., max 1 upgrade per hour) and implement a cooldown period after each upgrade attempt

findings.title: Error details exposed in API responses
findings.description: The handleGatewayError method passes raw error data to HttpException, potentially exposing internal system details to clients.
findings.snippet: throw new HttpException(data ?? "Akshare gateway request failed", status);
findings.suggested_issue: Sanitize error responses to remove internal details, log full errors server-side only

findings.title: Potential ReDoS in date parsing regex
findings.description: The parseDate method uses multiple regex patterns to match time formats. While the current patterns are simple, complex input strings could cause performance issues.
findings.suggested_issue: Add input length validation before regex matching to prevent potential ReDoS attacks

findings.title: No validation on slug parameter for triggerDataFetch
findings.description: The triggerDataFetch mutation accepts an array of slugs without validation. Invalid slugs will fail silently, but this could be used to probe for valid data item names.
findings.suggested_issue: Validate slugs against existing data items before queuing jobs, return specific errors for invalid slugs

findings.title: Raw external API response stored without sanitization
findings.description: The fetchAndPersist method stores raw payload from external akshare API directly to MongoDB without sanitization. Malicious data from compromised upstream could be persisted.
findings.suggested_issue: Implement payload schema validation before storage, sanitize or reject unexpected data structures
